title: client.beta.files and client.beta.skills no longer send beta headers and return new response shapes
detail: In Python SDK 1.2.0, TypeScript SDK 0.122.0, Go SDK 1.68.0, Java SDK 2.59.0, Ruby SDK 1.67.0, and C# SDK 12.44.0, accessing files or skills through the beta namespace now behaves identically to the non-beta namespace — the old beta headers are not sent and the old beta response shapes are not returned. Additionally, `client.beta.skills.delete()` now deletes a Skill together with all of its versions, and the type `BetaSkill` is renamed to `BetaContainerSkill`.
fix: Migrate your code to use `client.files` and `client.skills` directly, update any references to `BetaSkill` to `BetaContainerSkill`, and account for the new delete-all-versions behavior of `client.beta.skills.delete()`; see the linked migration guides for before-and-after details.

title: Python SDK v1.0 moves HTTP layer from httpx to httpx2; custom http_client objects must be rebuilt from httpx2
detail: Python SDK v1.0 replaces the `httpx` dependency with `httpx2`. Any code that constructs custom `http_client`, `Timeout`, or transport objects using the `httpx` package must be updated to import from `httpx2` instead. Code that relies on tracing or mocking libraries that patch `httpx` must call `httpx2.alias_httpx()` at startup to preserve that behavior.
fix: Replace `import httpx` with `import httpx2` (or use the alias helper) when building custom HTTP clients or transports passed to the Anthropic SDK, and call `httpx2.alias_httpx()` at startup if you use any library that monkey-patches `httpx`.

title: Python SDK v1.0 removes the legacy Text Completions API surface
detail: Python SDK v1.0 removes the long-deprecated Text Completions API. Any code that calls the legacy completions endpoint through the SDK will break after upgrading to v1.0.
fix: Migrate all Text Completions calls to the Messages API before upgrading to Python SDK v1.0.

title: Python SDK v1.0 removes temperature, top_p, and top_k parameters from Messages methods
detail: Python SDK v1.0 removes the `temperature`, `top_p`, and `top_k` parameters from Messages API methods, as these were long-deprecated on that surface. Passing these parameters after upgrading will cause an error.
fix: Remove `temperature`, `top_p`, and `top_k` arguments from all Messages API calls in your codebase before upgrading to Python SDK v1.0.

title: Python SDK v1.0 removes the tool runner's client-side compaction_control
detail: Python SDK v1.0 removes the `compaction_control` option from the client-side tool runner. Code that passes this parameter will break after upgrading.
fix: Remove any use of `compaction_control` from tool runner calls before upgrading to Python SDK v1.0.

title: Python SDK v1.0 async client: .with_raw_response results require await response.parse()
detail: On the async client in Python SDK v1.0, results from `.with_raw_response` now require `await response.parse()` to extract the parsed object. Existing code that accesses the parsed result synchronously will silently misbehave or error.
fix: Update all async `.with_raw_response` usages to call `await response.parse()` instead of accessing the result without awaiting.

title: Python SDK v1.0 AnthropicBedrock raises an error when no AWS region is configured
detail: In Python SDK v1.0, `AnthropicBedrock` no longer silently defaults to `us-east-1` when no AWS region is configured; it now raises an error instead. Code that relies on the implicit default region will break.
fix: Ensure an AWS region is explicitly configured (via environment variable or constructor argument) before constructing an `AnthropicBedrock` client.

title: Python SDK v1.0 requires Python 3.10 or later
detail: Python SDK v1.0 drops support for Python versions below 3.10. Projects running on Python 3.8 or 3.9 cannot upgrade to v1.0 without also upgrading their Python runtime.
fix: Upgrade your Python runtime to 3.10 or later before installing Python SDK v1.0.

title: On Claude Opus 5, disabling thinking with effort xhigh or max returns a 400 error
detail: Claude Opus 5 does not allow `thinking: {"type": "disabled"}` when `effort` is set to `xhigh` or `max`; the API returns a 400 error. This is a breaking change from Claude Opus 4.8, which permitted disabling thinking at any effort level.
fix: When targeting Claude Opus 5 with `xhigh` or `max` effort, remove the `thinking: {"type": "disabled"}` parameter or lower the effort level to `high` or below.

title: Fast mode removed for Claude Opus 4.7; requests with speed: fast now return an error
detail: Requests to `claude-opus-4-7` that include `speed: "fast"` now return an error rather than falling back to standard speed. Fast mode is no longer available for this model at all.
fix: Remove `speed: "fast"` from requests targeting `claude-opus-4-7`, or migrate to Claude Opus 5 or Claude Opus 4.8 if fast mode is required.

title: Claude Opus 4.1 retired; all API requests to this model now return an error
detail: The `claude-opus-4-1-20250805` model has been retired. Any API request targeting this model identifier will return an error.
fix: Update your model identifier from `claude-opus-4-1-20250805` to a current model such as `claude-opus-5`.

title: Experimental prompt generation/improvement/templatize endpoints retired on August 17, 2026
detail: The endpoints `/v1/experimental/generate_prompt`, `/v1/experimental/improve_prompt`, and `/v1/experimental/templatize_prompt` are being retired alongside the legacy Workbench on August 17, 2026. After that date, requests to these endpoints will return an error.
fix: Remove or replace any code that calls these experimental prompt-tool endpoints before August 17, 2026.

title: managed-agents-2026-04-01 header adopts new memory listing behavior on July 22, 2026
detail: On July 22, 2026, the `managed-agents-2026-04-01` beta header on memory store list endpoints adopted the same changed behavior as `agent-memory-2026-07-22`: results in a stable server-defined order (ignoring `order_by`/`order`), `depth` restricted to `0`, `1`, or omitted, and `path_prefix` must end with `/` and matches whole path segments. Existing page cursors issued before adoption are not valid and require restarting from the first page.
fix: Audit any code that calls memory list endpoints with `managed-agents-2026-04-01` and update `order_by`/`order` usage, `depth` values, and `path_prefix` patterns to conform to the new behavior, then restart pagination from page one.

title: Upgrading to computer_toolset_20260801 changes request shape and tool handling vs. beta computer_20251124
detail: The computer use tool is now out of beta as `computer_toolset_20260801`. Upgrading an existing integration from the earlier beta version (`computer_20251124`) changes the request shape and how tools are handled, including batch actions and zoom enabled by default.
fix: Follow the migration guide at the `#migrate-from-computer_20251124` anchor before switching from the beta `computer_20251124` to the GA `computer_toolset_20260801` toolset.
